attempts.summary: Installed a root crontab entry on node1 to run /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance daily at 02:15, appending stdout/stderr to /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log. Verified crond is active/enabled and the job executes and writes to the log. Performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured baseline boot_id/uptime, issued a native reboot, polled until exec was available again, confirmed the boot_id changed (proving an actual restart), and verified crond, the crontab entry, script executable bit, and the retained log content all survived the restart.
